## Main research themes

```{=html}
<div class="card-grid publication-themes">
  <div class="info-card"><h3>Biaxial testing & shear</h3><p>Cruciform specimens, tension–compression and compression–compression tests, shear characterisation, stability and standardisation.</p></div>
  <div class="info-card"><h3>Non-linearity & damage</h3><p>Pseudo-ductility, angle-ply laminates, cyclic loading, impact and progressive changes in stiffness.</p></div>
```
